item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "f61d10d84b8eec32f8e371e980eab1ab430ba827f77f9dbae17b794ae01839d8",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "A type indexed by two real parameters K and ρ. The supplied constructor D008 describes a bundle containing ρ ≠ 0, two real-valued functions p and u of two real variables, and satisfaction of D009 at every point.",
      "effect_on_target": "The universally quantified system supplies p and u together with the nonzero-density and differential-equation conditions described by D008.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "Projects the second field of the system, its pressure function p : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies p in the combination p − ρcu.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "Projects the third field of the system, its velocity function u : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies u in the combination p − ρcu.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "For real-valued w, this is exactly D007 w speed x t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Each occurrence asserts existence of both partial derivatives at the specified point and the equation w_t + speed·w_x = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "Maps p, u, ρ, c to the function (x,t) ↦ p(x,t) − (ρc)u(x,t).",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the particular system-derived quantity whose transport equation is concluded.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "For any codomain E, profile f : ℝ → E and real speed s, defines (x,t) ↦ f(x − st).",
      "effect_on_target": "With E = ℝ and s = −c, the profile field is f(x + ct).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "LocalDef007",
      "meaning": "For q valued in a real normed vector space, asserts existence of qt and qx such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative qt at t, ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) has derivative qx at x, and qt + speed • qx = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specializes to real-valued fields and speed −c, so the equation is qt − cqx = 0. The derivative witnesses are local to each point.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "LocalDef008",
      "meaning": "Constructs a system at parameters K and ρ from a proof ρ ≠ 0, functions p and u, and a proof of D009 p u K ρ x t for every real x and t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Exposes the mathematical data and global pointwise PDE assumptions bundled into the system argument.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "LocalDef009",
      "meaning": "At (x,t), there exist real pt, px, ut, ux giving respectively the time and space derivatives of p and u, with pt + Kux = 0 and ut + ρ⁻¹px = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "The system requires both first partial derivatives of both functions at every point, satisfying these two equations. Witnesses may depend on the system and the point.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "LocalDef010",
      "meaning": "Scalar multiplication by real numbers is jointly continuous on any real normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuity infrastructure for the derivative predicates in D007; adds no separate hypothesis on the target's real-valued fields.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "LocalDef011",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication on ℝ is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real derivative predicates in the system equations without an additional assumption.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires all three principal conclusions and all derivative and equation conditions in the nested conjunctions simultaneously.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "ContinuousMul.to_continuousSMul",
      "meaning": "Continuous multiplication gives continuous scalar multiplication of a type on itself via multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the continuity of the real scalar action used in HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Retains a densely normed field's normed-field structure and obtains its nontrivial norm property.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows ℝ to serve as the scalar field for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "DivInvMonoid.toDiv",
      "meaning": "Extracts the division operation from a division-and-inversion monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects real division in K/ρ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses exact zero residuals in the PDEs and exact equality of the profile field with f(x + ct).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts the addition operation supplied by its instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Represents real addition in profile arguments and PDE residuals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "HDiv.hDiv",
      "meaning": "Extracts the division operation supplied by its instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms K/ρ under the square root.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplication operation supplied by its instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms the real products ct, ρc, (ρc)u and the coefficients in the system equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the specified derivative at the specified point, using the neighborhood filter at that point and a fixed base point.",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts ordinary real derivatives, with no restriction to a subset or one-sided domain. It supplies the precise differentiability meaning for the profile and partial derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Forgets the extra ring structure in the assertion that ring operations are continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the derivation of continuous real multiplication required for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toContinuousMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts continuity of multiplication from a topological semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of real multiplication and hence of the real scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "Extracts the strict comparison relation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses strict positivity of K, ρ and √(K/ρ).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "Neg.neg",
      "meaning": "Extracts additive negation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Sets the transport and profile speed to −√(K/ρ).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the operations and commutativity while forgetting the associativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a weaker real algebraic structure used to obtain topological instances; does not alter the operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplication commutativity from the indicated ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies algebraic infrastructure for continuity of real operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, multiplication, zero and distributivity while forgetting additive inverses.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the topological-semiring route to continuous real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the norm and metric data while retaining the nonunital commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real algebraic operations underlying topological instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplication commutativity while retaining the seminormed ring data.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports construction of the real seminormed additive structure used for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive commutative group and pseudometric from a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive normed setting for the real scalar module in HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed-field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the usual real normed-field operations and topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed commutative ring operations and metric while forgetting the unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a compatible real structure used in the continuity instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Views a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring with the same operations and distance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides compatible additive and topological structures for real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets division from a normed field while retaining its normed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real ring and metric infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A normed field is a normed vector space over itself, with scalar multiplication given by multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the real codomain a real normed vector space and identifies scalar multiplication with real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying scalar module of a normed space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real module structure required by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral in the selected type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the displayed numeral 0 as real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects real distance to the topology used in derivative limits.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "All parameters, independent variables, field values and derivative values in the target are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Equips ℝ with its normed-field structure and density of attainable positive norms.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar-field structure needed for ordinary real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "The real addition operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes addition in x + ct and the differential equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative group structure on ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies addition, zero and additive inverses for real derivative values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "Real.instDivInvMonoid",
      "meaning": "Real multiplication, inversion and division, with division equal to multiplication by the inverse.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets K/ρ as Kρ⁻¹.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The strict order on ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Gives the usual meaning to the three positivity statements.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "The real multiplication operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes all real products in the formulas.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "Real.instNeg",
      "meaning": "Real additive negation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes −c the negative of the positive square root c.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The real number zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the comparison baseline and zero PDE residual.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The real commutative ring with its usual norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides compatible real algebraic and analytic structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field with its usual norm and metric, including totalized inversion with inverse zero equal to zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the analytic field for derivatives and division. Positive density excludes the exceptional zero-denominator case.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Real distance is d(x,y) = |x − y|.",
      "effect_on_target": "Derivative and continuity assertions use the ordinary real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Real.sqrt",
      "meaning": "Takes the nonnegative square root after converting the argument to a nonnegative real; negative real inputs are truncated to zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines c = √(K/ρ). The positive-parameter hypotheses make its argument positive, and the target concludes c > 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the unit requirement while retaining the seminormed commutative ring operations and pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the compatible real seminormed additive structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplication commutativity in a seminormed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports extraction of the topology used for real derivative values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric of a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real metric-based topology in the derivative instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology underlying a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides neighborhoods and continuity for the real derivative predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 using the selected zero element.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures that numeral zero denotes real zero in the explicit target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary addition as the heterogeneous-addition operation when all types coincide.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves displayed additions to real addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "instHDiv",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary division as the heterogeneous-division operation when all types coincide.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves K/ρ to real division.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "instHMul",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary multiplication as the heterogeneous-multiplication operation when all types coincide.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves products in the target to real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "instIsTopologicalRingReal",
      "meaning": "The real ring operations are continuous in the real topology.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuous multiplication and scalar multiplication for real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Extracts the subtraction operation supplied by its instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses p − ρcu and the translated profile argument x − st.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Real.instSub",
      "meaning": "Defines a − b as a + (−b) in ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes x − (−c)t equal to x + ct and fixes the minus sign in p − ρcu.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The real additive commutative group with its norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Instantiates the codomain assumptions of the transport predicate at ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "instHSub",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary subtraction as heterogeneous subtraction when the types coincide.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves the subtraction in both field definitions to real subtraction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Views an additive commutative group as a commutative subtraction monoid, retaining its subtraction and negation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited additive structure, including the route to zero in D007.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "AddCommMagma.toAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition from a commutative additive magma.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies codomain addition in qt + speed • qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Forgets the zero element requirement while retaining associative commutative addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the inheritance path supplying addition in D007.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma",
      "meaning": "Retains commutative addition while forgetting the associativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the inheritance path selecting the transport residual's addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, zero and the additive identity laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies zero-compatible additive structure for scalar-action instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "AddZero.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts the zero element from an addition-and-zero structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the codomain zero used by inherited scalar-action structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "AddZeroClass.toAddZero",
      "meaning": "Retains addition and zero while forgetting their identity laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the zero instance needed for the transport predicate's scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul",
      "meaning": "Retains scalar multiplication and its preservation of zero and addition from a distributive multiplicative action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar action appearing in speed • qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains scalar multiplication and its preservation of zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the inheritance path to scalar multiplication in D007.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Views an extended-normed additive commutative monoid as an extended-seminormed one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports inherited additive operations for the general codomain in D007; adds no extra target restriction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative monoid from an extended-seminormed additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies addition and zero for the general transport residual.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets additive commutativity from the extended-seminormed structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports extraction of the underlying additive monoid.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid from an extended-seminormed additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited addition and zero for D007's algebraic instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over an object satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Binds derivative values locally: two in each transport assertion and four in each system-equation assertion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms speed • qx, which is ordinary multiplication for the real-valued target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action underlying a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real normed-space structure to scalar multiplication in the transport equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "Ne",
      "meaning": "Inequality, defined as the negation of equality.",
      "effect_on_target": "The system constructor requires ρ ≠ 0, already implied by the target's assumption ρ > 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "NegZeroClass.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts the zero element from a structure with negation preserving zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the zero on the right-hand side of the general transport residual.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "A normed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "D007 uses this structure on its codomain; the target specializes it to ℝ, with no abstract codomain quantified in the target itself.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative group from a normed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the codomain group operations required by derivative predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Equips a normed additive commutative group with its associated extended-normed additive commutative monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an inheritance route to the same codomain addition and zero used in D007.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group and induced pseudometric while weakening the normed structure to a seminormed one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the codomain structure needed by the real normed-space and topology instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "NormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A scalar module over a normed field with norm-compatible scalar multiplication.",
